get_local_torch_device: get the local torch XPU device for the current process rank
get_device_capability: get the device capability (major, minor) for an Intel XPU device
get_available_gpu_memory: get available GPU memory in GiB for an Intel XPU device with optional distributed sync
get_attn_backend_cls_str: get the attention backend class string for Intel XPU with dtype and head size constraints
get_device_communicator_cls: get the device communicator class for Intel XPU distributed communication
